description: Outbox events M00 emits. A consumer fixture suite asserts these against any provider. Envelope fields are frozen by contracts/common/event-envelope.schema.json; only payload is module-owned.

events.emitted_when: A note is created. Appended in the SAME transaction as the row; a rollback removes both.
A note is updated. aggregate_version is the version AFTER the write, so a consumer can detect a missed event as a gap.
